eligibility.rule: every message in the returned prefix has exactly one correctly attributed qualifying event
eligibility.score_identity: q=16*m+2 only when m prefix messages each have one unique qualifying host event; otherwise use actual scorer output and reject identity check
validity_conditions: qualifying event class matches the bound SDK scorer
one unique host identity is assigned per returned message
no extra reward or penalty term applies
candidate cap is charged once per returned finding

shared_kernel.before_path: stop iff cap full or observed remaining generation time<=0.1 seconds; otherwise start without future-cost lookahead
shared_kernel.before_interaction: stop current path iff observed remaining generation time<=0.1 seconds; otherwise perform exactly one interaction and charge observed elapsed generation time
shared_kernel.event_attribution: difference indexed trace suffixes after each interaction and bind qualifying events to that message index
shared_kernel.salvage_rule: from the method-permitted prefix set, return the longest completed prefix satisfying exact per-message eligibility whose ledger replay charge fits; otherwise drop
shared_kernel.after_return: charge one candidate slot and the selected ledger replay amount; record actual replay separately by replaying the exact returned prefix in a fresh environment
shared_kernel.state_transition: for monotone methods state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); after drop state=1; state never increases
shared_kernel.overage: generation overage, actual replay above 2.0 seconds, timeout, invalid attribution, duplicate host or incomplete artifact invalidates that method-cell
shared_kernel.sequence_truncation: a method stops at the first shared-kernel stop; no skipped proposal or later resumption
prohibited: aggregate event count as prefix eligibility
different salvage semantics outside the named no-salvage removal

hcms_calibrated.proposal: always propose current monotone state, initialized to 24

fixed8_calibrated.proposal: always propose min(8,current monotone state), initialized to 8

hcms_scalar.proposal: always propose current monotone state, initialized to 24

contribution_components.role: amortize candidate boundary cost when 24 succeeds and permanently preserve the longest exact shorter prefix when it does not
contribution_components.measured_bottleneck: failed antecedent artifact has 24-favoring cells 6/9 and natural context-cliff cells 3/9; symmetric audit raw HCMS=17446, fixed8=12090, fixed24-no-salvage=10036

contribution_components.role: reserve replay capacity with a measured first-message-correlated surrogate
contribution_components.measured_bottleneck: scalar 1.10 misses 84/90 replay pairs and full retrospective scalar controller overruns actual replay in 7/9 cells; calibrated heldout coverage is 54/54 and retrospective overage 0/9
contribution_components.decision: hcms calibrated actual replay coverage=1.0 and overage=0 while hcms_scalar actual replay overage cells>=1

correctness_controls.test: three frozen fixtures including concentrated events that make aggregate coverage 1.0 but exact prefix coverage 0.25
time-zero admissibility plus mid-path abort and longest-completed-prefix fixtures

antecedent_evidence.threshold_rationale: the 1.10 fresh-batch materiality floor is less than one quarter of the smaller 44.301 percent antecedent relative gain and pays for added state and replay-accounting complexity

phase3.order_design: four-treatment Williams design; each method once per ordinal position and every directed predecessor pair exactly once
phase3.aggregation: sum constrained raw over the 36 valid method repetitions per method (3 profiles x 3 masters x 4 paired orders); delayed safety raw is excluded
